u: 5月25日晚间，赛力斯发布公告称，公司旗下重庆蓝电科技有限公司（以下简称蓝电科技）拟获增资约66.71亿元，参与方新增宁波梅山保税港区问鼎投资有限公司（以下简称问鼎投资）、博俊科技、星宇股份。
蓝电科技的主要资产是蓝电汽车，而问鼎投资是宁德时代的全资子公司。
若完成上述交易，宁德时代参股的车企将再添一家。
天眼查显示，宁德时代通过问鼎投资，参股了奇瑞汽车、智己汽车、爱驰汽车、哪吒汽车等车企。
赛力斯“放手” 蓝电科技参与增资方新增3家上市公司
4月22日，赛力斯董事会审议通过议案，同意蓝电科技增加注册资本6.8亿元，涉及增资金额不超过72亿元。
赛力斯放弃对蓝电科技新增注册资本的优先认购权。
5月25日，蓝电科技、赛力斯汽车（湖北）有限公司与重庆沙磁致远新能源科技合伙企业（有限合伙）（以下简称沙磁致远）、重庆岳行嘉升企业管理合伙企业（有限合伙）（以下简称岳行嘉升）、问鼎投资、博俊科技、星宇股份签署了《增资协议》及《股东协议》。
按照上述协议，蓝电科技拟合计获得的增资约为66.71亿元，参与增资方包含赛力斯此前公告提及的沙磁致远、岳行嘉升，拟分别以现金出资约34.33亿元、16.39亿元，采取分期方式支付。
岳行嘉升是蓝电科技的员工持股平台。
沙磁致远成立于2026年4月13日，大股东是重庆市沙坪坝区国有资产监督管理委员会旗下公司。
同时，蓝电科技将迎来三名新的增资方，分别是问鼎投资、博俊科技、星宇股份。
按照上述协议，问鼎投资、博俊科技、星宇股份拟分别以现金方式，向蓝电科技出资9.84亿元、5.12亿元、1.02亿元。
蓝电科技完成上述增资扩股后，沙磁致远、岳行嘉升分别成为第一、第三大股东，持股比例分别为34.5005%、16.4779%。
问鼎投资、博俊科技、星宇股份将分别成为蓝电科技的第四、第五、第六大股东，持股比例分别为9.8867%、5.1493%、1.0299%。
赛力斯此前公告称，蓝电科技完成本轮增资扩股，公司将不再拥有对蓝电科技的控制权。
公司对蓝电科技的财务核算，将由成本法变为权益法，预计带来一定的投资收益。
截至5月25日收盘，赛力斯A股股价报82.08元/股，总市值达1407亿元。

u: The expansion – which includes the construction of a new flotation plant and the development of underground mining – represents a total capital investment of $490 million (100% basis), to be deployed across FY27 and FY28.
The investment breaks down across three key areas: a flotation plant ($240M), underground pre-production development ($220M) and non-processing infrastructure ($30M).
At the current spot spodumene price of approximately US$2,700/t SC6, the payback period is expected to be less than one year¹.

The flotation plant and underground mining program are expected to deliver meaningful improvements to the Mt Marion operation, supporting mine life through access to additional mineral resources below the existing open pit.

The projects will also guide improved plant recoveries, targeting approximately 70%, increased installed capacity from ~500ktpa SC6 to 600ktpa SC6 and remove the lower-grade SC3.5 product to deliver a single SC5 product.
Tendering for an underground mining contractor is already underway, with central underground development expected to commence in Q1 FY27.
From FY28, Mt Marion will operate as a combined open pit and underground mine, with underground ore from open stoping expected to supplement up to 40% of processing feed.

The flotation circuit will be built alongside the existing dense media separation plant to recover fine spodumene currently lost to tailings, constructed and operated by MinRes' Mining Services division. Construction is targeted to begin in Q1 FY27, with commissioning and ramp-up scheduled for 2H FY28.
Minimal disruption to existing operations is expected during construction and commissioning. The site's accommodation camp will also be expanded from 500 to 750 rooms to support both projects.
MinRes Managing Director Chris Ellison welcomed the decision.

"This high-return brownfield investment sets up Mt Marion for decades to come. Underground mining and flotation will work together to access deeper high-grade ore, lift recoveries and produce a single 5% product,” Ellison said.
"I thank our partner Ganfeng for their collaboration on the design and commitment to these projects, which will ensure we unlock the full potential of Mt Marion."
Learn more about the MinRes Lithium business.
¹ Payback period based on current spot spodumene price of approximately US$2,700/t SC6.

u: The appointment marks a significant milestone in the progression of underground mining at Mt Marion and signals the next phase of development at one of Australia's leading lithium operations.
MinRes Underground Mine Planning Manager Andrew Cooper said the appointment brings the right expertise to unlock the long-term potential of the Mt Marion orebody.
"We're focused on systematically building the technical and operational capability to unlock the full potential of the Mt Marion orebody," Cooper said.
"We had to pause and be patient while the market worked through its challenges, but that time wasn't wasted. We've come back sharper, better planned and with a team ready to deliver.
"Macmahon brings proven underground expertise to support our mining plans and together we're focused on executing this safely and efficiently."
Cooper said the relationship with Macmahon goes beyond a typical contractor arrangement.
"Macmahon will be an integral part of our team. Close collaboration is what it takes to deliver a project of this scale,” he said.

Macmahon Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer Michael Finnegan welcomed the contract award, highlighting the opportunity for both companies to forge a strong and productive working relationship.
“Macmahon is excited to partner with MinRes and Jiangxi Ganfeng Lithium to deliver the next phase of underground mining at Mt Marion," Finnegan said.

"This is a high-quality, long-term opportunity to collaborate alongside strong, aligned partners and positions Macmahon Underground firmly on the global stage as a tier one contractor in future-facing commodities.
"We look forward to working closely with the joint venture to unlock the full potential of this operation and support its continued growth as a globally significant lithium asset.”
This appointment is the culmination of a journey that began in early 2024, when MinRes commenced preliminary works to support future underground mining at Mt Marion.
A diamond drilling program followed, significantly increasing confidence in the underground resource within the mine's upper North Pit and confirming the orebody's potential.
The program was placed on hold in response to softened lithium prices, but sustained improvement in market conditions has since prompted MinRes and Ganfeng to push ahead with underground development.
In May 2026, MinRes announced a Final Investment Decision (FID) for underground mining at Mt Marion, alongside the construction of a flotation plant and camp expansion.
Underground development is expected to commence in the first quarter of FY27, with Mt Marion operating as a combined open pit and underground operation from FY28.

Underground development and a new flotation plant are together expected to support mine life, improve plant recovery towards 70%, increase installed capacity to approximately 600ktpa SC6 and deliver a single, higher-quality SC5 product.
MinRes Chief Executive Lithium Joshua Thurlow said the underground program represents a defining moment for the business.
“We’ve barely scratched the surface of what Mt Marion can deliver,” Thurlow said.
“Underground mining is the next step in realising the full value of this world-class asset and we’re building the team and the infrastructure to make it happen.”
Learn more about MinRes Lithium business and sites.
